description: Weekly sensor and asset summary for the hospital.
name: Weekly report

description: Live pick-events mix — sells, moves, returns, picks.
name: Warehouse Activity Overview

description: Number of pick events per worker.
name: Top Workers by Activity

description: Share of pick events per forklift.
name: Forklift Utilization

description: Full-warehouse rack inventory snapshot: KPIs for blocked/expired/empty, status mix, ABC class distribution, temperature zones, and the full bin table.
name: Rack Health Dashboard

bindings.content:
## Rack Health
Operational snapshot across every rack cell in Acme Warehouse. Colour-coded chips call out status urgency.

description: Rack cells whose stored stock is nearing expiry. Slider controls the horizon; table sorts soonest first.
name: Bin Expiration Watchlist

bindings.content:
## Expiration Watchlist
Use the date picker at the top to slide the horizon. Rows below are sorted **soonest expiring first**.

description: How the racks are used — pallet type mix and temperature-zone footprint. Useful when planning cold-chain expansion or pallet-type retrofits.
name: Pallet & Zone Distribution

description: Warehouse-wide items snapshot: total count, total quantity in stock, distinct SKUs / owners, and the mix by category.
name: Inventory Overview

description: Who owns what. Portfolio breakdown by customer / 3PL, cross-tabbed against product category — useful for consignment billing and space allocation.
name: Owner Portfolio

description: Filterable expiration watchlist for individual items (not bins). Pick a horizon date and a category dropdown.
name: Items Expiring Soon

bindings.content:
## Items Expiring Soon
Pick a date at the top to slide the window. Category dropdown is available for scoping; a real spec would wire it into the filter below.

description: Every item currently flagged as recalled or damaged, with SKU, owner, quantity, and last-known bin. High-severity report — export to CSV and clear promptly.
name: Recall & Damage Report

bindings.content:
## ⚠️  Recall & Damage
Items below need immediate operator attention. Recalled stock must be pulled from active bins; damaged stock routed to QA quarantine.

description: Live picture of the crew: who is on shift, by role and state, plus todays pick counts per worker.
name: Workforce Snapshot

description: Every pick-event as it happens: worker, forklift, item, from/to bins, quantity. Filter by event type via the dropdown at the top.
name: Activity Feed

bindings.content:
## Live Activity Feed
Stream of the most-recent 500 events. Newest first.

description: Which products move most, sell most, and get returned most. Group by SKU / category to spot velocity hot-spots or over-recall SKUs.
name: Product Movement Insights

description: Executive snapshot — SKUs, staff on shift, live sales, and traffic hot spots across the whole store.
name: Store Overview

bindings.content:
## Acme Supermarket — Live Overview
Cross-cutting KPIs for the last operating window. Drill into individual reports for detail.

description: Deep-dive on POS transactions — revenue, basket size, payment mix, lane throughput.
name: Sales Performance

description: Per-cashier throughput — transactions, revenue, and average basket.
name: Cashier Performance

description: SKU master — full catalogue with department breakdown, pricing, and brand mix.
name: Product Catalogue

description: Planogram distribution — placements per aisle and department, facings audit.
name: Shelf Placement Audit

description: On-hand inventory with restock alerts — needs-restock flags, aisle rollup, low-stock table.
name: Stock Health

bindings.content:
## Stock Health
Watch the **Needs restock** count in amber — anything > 15 warrants a stocker sweep this shift.

description: Anonymized foot traffic per department per 5-minute bucket — entries, dwell time, unique visitors.
name: Customer Traffic

description: Fire-extinguisher and first-aid registry — inspection status, pressure readings, due dates.
name: Safety Compliance

description: Inbound deliveries at the receiving dock — supplier mix, pallet throughput, dock utilization.
name: Receiving Activity

description: In-store offers — discount depth, department mix, expiring promos.
name: Active Promotions

description: Full staff roster — role mix, shift coverage, and current-zone assignment.
name: Workforce Roster
